name: Bethany Kowalczyk
situation: Bethany is 38 and lives in Columbus, Ohio, with her husband and three children, ages 4, 9 and 12. She works three days a week as a dental hygienist and runs the household calendar: school, sports, appointments, meals, the budget and a slowly growing list of house projects.
domains: the family calendar: school, activities and appointments
meal planning, groceries and the budget
the kids' health, school and friendships
her work schedule and her own time
agent_role: Her family organizer: it keeps the calendar and lists, plans meals around the week, tracks forms, payments and appointments, and remembers the details of each kid's world.
voice: Warm and fast, lots of lists, often written in the car line; she uses the kids' nicknames.
agent_voice: Warm and organized: checklists, who needs what by when, gentle reminders, uses the kids' names.

people.name: Darnell Kowalczyk
people.relation: her husband, an HVAC sales rep

people.name: Patrice Oduya
people.relation: her best friend and carpool partner
